theme_and_art_direction: Premium PropTech. A sophisticated blend of Apple's clarity, Airbnb's search mechanics, Stripe's kinetic motion, and Awwwards-level craft. It must feel like an exclusive, intelligent platform. Emphasize 'The Swiss Grid' combined with fluid, purposeful motion. Negative space is a primary design material. High contrast in typography, layered soft glassmorphism, and deep rich colors.

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium
scales.label: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold

rules: Never center text by default; use left-alignment for dynamic tension.
Apply tight letter spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em) on all headings above 32px.
Labels and overlines must be uppercase with wide tracking.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A for Marketing). 12-column foundation.

motion_and_interaction.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load. Slow, deliberate easing [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].
motion_and_interaction.scroll_animations: Elements fade and translate Y slightly on scroll. Use staggered children for grids.
motion_and_interaction.hover_effects: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-2) with expanded shadow. Image scale-up (1.05) inside hidden overflow container.
motion_and_interaction.magnetic_buttons: Apply Framer Motion magnetic pull to primary CTAs.
motion_and_interaction.markers: Map markers gently pulse (scale 1 to 1.1) infinitely. On hover, they expand to show property preview card with spring physics.

hero_section.background: Aerial image with dark gradient overlay (bg-black/40 to bg-black/80 at bottom).
hero_section.content: Large kinetic typography. Floating map markers positioned absolutely over the image using percentages (e.g., top-1/4 left-1/3).

search_bar.layout: Flex row, divided by subtle vertical borders. Pill shaped (rounded-full). sticky top-24 z-40.

feature_cards.interactions: Hover reveals subtle gradient border or tracing beam effect.

forms.style: Shadcn based but restyled. Floating labels, minimal borders (border-b only or highly rounded inputs).

hero_aerial.description: Lagos aerial skyline for the main hero background.

agent_profile_1.description: Professional African agent/businessman in front of building.

agent_profile_2.description: African business professional in urban setting.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis (or lenis), @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Implement the Dark Mode toggle using standard React context or next-themes.
Do not use generic 'Inter' for H1/H2. Import and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or 'Satoshi' via Google Fonts or Fontshare.

The Hero Section must be dramatic. Use the provided Lagos aerial image. Overlay it with a dark gradient so the large kinetic text is perfectly readable. Add 5-6 absolute positioned pulsing dots (markers) that reveal a tiny property card on hover using framer-motion.
Implement the 'Floating Airbnb-style Search Bar' just below the hero or overlapping the bottom of the hero.
Use large paddings (py-32). Build asymmetrical bento-box grids for the 'What AMASS Does' section.
Build Shadcn forms for lead capture but override the default Vercel aesthetic to match the Apple/Stripe premium feel (rounded corners, high contrast focus states).
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Dropdown/Select and Calendar.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, parallax).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
